Whole-keyspace overview: server stats (memory, hit rate, uptime) plus a keys-per-prefix breakdown of the top tree level. Shown when nothing is selected in the browser.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/cache-browser/CacheStatsOverview.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CacheStatsOverview } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
